motivation: One small step now beats the perfect plan later.
You don't have to do it all. Just the next thing.
Small and finished beats big and half done.
What runs today, you can make prettier tomorrow.
You're doing well. Keep going, at your own pace.

motivation.t: Good morning. Pick one goal for today, then off we go.
Good evening. What was today's best moment in the project?
Almost time: {left} until the jam starts. Tools ready?
Submitted. I'm proud of you. Now celebrate, then sleep.

dragon: I guard your scope. It is my treasure, and it stays small.
Small fire, big effect. True for features too.
I didn't eat the bug. But I'll hold it down until you get here.
Dragons hoard gold. You hoard builds that run. Both are wise.

dragon.t: Psst. I'm only dozing. Wake me if something is on fire.
The sun is warm on my scales. Good moment for the hard task.

design: Core loop first: what does the player do every ten seconds?
Juice turns a mechanic into a feeling: sound, screen shake, a few particles.
Playtest early. Other hands find in two minutes what you no longer see.
The theme may surprise. The third idea is often better than the first.
Cutting is design. Nobody misses what they never saw.
The first minute decides. Can I do something right away, and do I know why?
One clear goal and clear feedback are worth more than three systems.
One mechanic in three situations beats three mechanics in one.

design.t: The theme is out. Collect ideas tonight, then sleep on them.

jam: Vertical slice first: start, one full run, end. Then build out.
Package early. The first build finds the bugs the editor hides.
Plan to submit with a buffer. Upload and page take longer than you think.
The video: 30 to 60 seconds, best part first. Record a rough cut early.
Write decisions into the devlog. The Glass Box lives on honest notes.
Commit when something works. A clean state is your best insurance.

jam.t: {left} until the deadline. What is the smallest version you'd be proud of?
{left} left. Cut now, don't build: bugs, build, page, video.
Stay calm. One feature less, one tested build more.

unreal: Test the packaged build, not just the editor. Cook and path errors show up there.
Before you submit, make a Shipping build and play it through once.
Lumen costs performance. Check the frame rate in the build and offer a lower setting.
DLSS needs an NVIDIA card. The TSR fallback has to work without the plugin.
Plug and unplug the controller, switch windows, open the menu: does input still work?
Listen to the audio in the build. Levels feel different there than in the editor.
break: A glass of water. I'll wait here and watch the code.
Shoulders down, one good stretch. Two minutes is enough.
Look out of the window for a moment. Your eyes will thank you.
Have you eaten? Dragons don't work on an empty belly either.

break.t: It's late. Write down the next step and go to sleep.
Tired decisions cost double tomorrow. Off to bed, I'll keep watch.
Still up? A sip of water, save, commit, lights out.
